event_discrimination.ordinary_union: Union hits>0 over registered ordinary traces, preserving each raw identity; all target members must remain zero in that baseline. This selection union is not replacement of per-run raw counts.
event_discrimination.positive: Spec-checker-clean multistep event completed within 384 new physical cycles, each mapped source member actually executed.
causal_controls: Prefix before the registered prerequisite/resolution leaves target sources unhit.
Same-budget control removing the prerequisite or resolution does not hit those source targets.
Separate event families cannot be counted from the same shared stall/reset/ready group.
event_discrimination.claims: Finite ordinary/control non-hits are evidence for the screening gate, not universal unreachability. Formal claims require separately proved assumptions. Plain mode selection is not a multistep target.

One three-repetition B development per frozen qualifying scope; no selective replacement or budget tightening.
C only after the unchanged B gate; fresh matched formal B, A/C and own-trajectory token-matched placebo require separate final freeze.

independence: WB safety and WB crossbar share upstream and skidbuffer, count as one lineage. AXIS RAM switch is a distinct packet-switch design from the previously used AXIS family; do not count as wholly unseen repository.

candidates.ordinary_policy: Ordinary trusted master legal reads/writes, isolated and pipelined depth 1/2/4/7, read/write directions and byte masks, no slave stall, exactly one response per accepted request, always in-order prompt ACK. Explicit ERR response and clean normal cycle close are ordinary. No starvation, timeout, unsolicited response, held-back response or reset during a transaction. Downstream fault injection is legal for this firewall; never mislabel it a trusted-master input violation.

candidates.public_contract_addendum: Public module/interface comments are separate cited intent; checker author must not receive executable RTL or formal implementation-specific properties.

candidates.ordinary_policy: Ordinary isolated reads/writes from each master to each mapped slave and unmapped address; direct mapped ranges 0x00-0x0f/0x10-0x1f.
